<@U0A67RK86BH> こちら私の方から連絡しておきました！　連絡待ちです。連絡きたら、linkを共有お願いします。
```Dear Dr. Wang,
Thank you so much for your coordination and for taking the time to arrange this meeting despite your busy schedule. We truly appreciate your efforts.

I would also like to mention that one of our team members, Eiko, will not be able to join us in person for this visit. Would it be possible to set up an online meeting so that she can participate remotely? We are happy to set up a Google Meet link on our end, but if it is more convenient for you to arrange the online meeting from your side, we would appreciate that as well.
Additionally, so that Eiko can plan which sessions to join, could you please confirm that the meeting will proceed in the order of the four topics we discussed previously (1, 2, 3, 4)?
Please also find attached the participant list and a brief overview of our organization for your reference.
Thank you again, and we look forward to seeing you on Friday.
Best regards, Naofumi Nishida```
